brief: A dark water coat whose painted caustics evolve without translating down the body.
palette_intent: Water art is subtle; the role fallback and contour dominate side reading.
motion_intent: Forty-eight-frame seamless loop with a calm resting first frame.
hint_rationale: The caustic shapes morph between drawn states rather than sliding as one formula.
prompt: Fill the exact pinned blank geometry guide with dark water and painted caustics: one flat right-facing continuous 16-cell-by-1-cell capsule, one-cell rounded head with a small centered dark core, rounded tail, neutral background, and no gaps, detached plates, perspective, or outside paint.
